speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Puerperal Endometritis with possible secondary ileus.

Doctor: Given the uterine tenderness, fever, and prolonged labor, I am concerned about an infection of the uterine lining. Have you noticed any foul-smelling lochia (vaginal discharge) or visible uterine deviation? Also, have you passed gas or had any bowel movements since delivery?
